name: Solomon Islands

fees.name: Visitor Visa - Tourist (e-visa)
fees.validity: 30 days on arrival, single entry, max stay up to 150 days
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa (not covered by visa-free/visitor-permit arrangements)
fees.notes: Standard visa fee is USD 100, plus a USD 50 online application/administration fee (total commonly cited as USD 150 for the e-visa). Fees are levied in USD and converted to Solomon Islands Dollars (SBD) at time of payment. Extension fee is also USD 100.

fees.name: e-Visa online application fee (surcharge added to visa fee)
fees.notes: Non-refundable online application/administration fee charged in addition to the underlying visa fee (e.g. USD 50 + USD 100 tourist visa = USD 150 total). Site notes online payment 'will be operational soon'; applications currently also accepted in person in Honiara.

fees.name: Business Visa (Short-Term)
fees.notes: Short-term business visa fee as published on the Immigration Division visa types page.

fees.name: Transit Visa (Commercial Maritime)
fees.validity: issued on arrival, 7 days (max stay up to 14 days)
fees.notes: Listed as a visa-on-arrival category for commercial maritime transit; no fee amount published on the official site, so left null rather than guessed.

free_visa_notes: Citizens of the US and most Commonwealth/EU/MSG (Melanesian Spearhead Group) countries can enter visa-free or receive a free visitor permit on arrival for up to 3 months within any 1-year period; the MSG visitor visa category is also listed as free (60 days, single entry). No official reciprocity fee schedule by nationality was found on immigration.gov.sb, so no per-nationality variations are recorded; only the general 'not required for many nationalities' vs 'visa required' distinction applies.
